exposure: French functional method (FFM) for clubfoot treatment
outcome: International Clubfoot Study Group evaluation system (ICFSG) score
cohort: 779 feet (patients not specified) treated for clubfoot with the FFM at a single center in France between 1993 and 2010.
finding: 86% of patients treated with the FFM for clubfoot had excellent or good outcomes at long-term follow-up, with minimal residual deformities.
